title: Bertelsmann powers creativity and productivity with OpenAI
summary: Bertelsmann, the global media, services, and education company headquartered in Germany, will integrate OpenAI’s technology across multiple brands around the world.
body: Bertelsmann, the global media, services, and education company headquartered in Germany, will integrate OpenAI’s technology across multiple brands around the world.
summaryZh: 全球知名传媒、服务与教育公司贝塔斯曼宣布将在其全球多个业务品牌中全面集成OpenAI的技术，以提升整体创造力与工作效率。原始信息显示：Bertelsmann, the global media, services, and education company headquartered in Germany, will integrate OpenAI’s technology across multiple brands around the world.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Bertelsmann powers creativity and productivity with OpenAI”。其重要性主要体现在：全球传媒巨头贝塔斯曼与OpenAI达成技术集成合作，展示了大模型在传统行业的实际落地。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
